description: Lists deprecated conversion event resources configured for a Google Analytics property. Google recommends using key events instead.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing conversion events on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListConversionEvents call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The resource name of the parent property. Format: 'properties/{propertyId}'
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsadminPropertiesConversioneventsListRequest

name: list_conversion_events

AnalyticsadminPropertiesConversionevents.description: Response model for listing conversion events.

conversionEvents.description: List of conversion events in the specified parent property
conversionEvents.title: Conversion Events

nextPageToken.description: A token which can be sent as pageToken to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

AnalyticsadminPropertiesConversionevents.title: AnalyticsadminPropertiesConversioneventsListResponse

createTime.description: Time when this conversion event was created in the property (google-datetime format)
createTime.title: Create Time

custom.description: Indicates whether the event is custom (true) or a default Google Analytics event (false)
custom.title: Custom

deletable.description: If true, this event can currently be deleted with DeleteConversionEvent
deletable.title: Deletable

eventName.description: The event name for this conversion event. Examples: 'click', 'purchase'
eventName.title: Event Name

name.description: Resource name of this conversion event. Format: properties/{property}/conversionEvents/{conversion_event}
name.title: Name
